resources.string: Album art with previous, play/pause and next for Spotify.
A home screen widget for Spotify: album art, previous, play/pause and next. Tap it to open Spotify\'s player.
Android only lets an app see what another app is playing if it has notification access. The widget uses it for Spotify\'s track, artwork and playback state, and nothing else.
Notification access granted. Add the widget from your home screen\'s widget picker, or use the button below.
